meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后，你的AI助手（Claude）可以通过Signal与您聊天。您用Signal向绑定的号码发送消息，助手会回复，支持Markdown、引用回复、语音消息（需转录）等功能。助手以您的Signal号码作为账户，也可加入群组。
howto.when: 当您通过Signal向助手绑定的号码发送消息（私聊或群组）时触发。新用户首次发送后需授权才能收到回复。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的日程安排
say.note: 助手会查询并回复你的日程

howto.what_en: Your AI assistant can now chat via Signal. It sends/receives messages using your linked phone number, supports Markdown, quoted replies, typing indicators, and voice messages (transcription available). Works in DMs and groups.
howto.when_en: When you send a message to the assistant's Signal number (DM or group). New users must be granted access after first message.

say_en.note: Assistant will retrieve your schedule and reply.

say_en.text: Set a reminder for 3 PM meeting
